# CFP Board

> The official governing body for CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER® certification, providing comprehensive standards, education, and resources for aspiring and practicing financial planning professionals.

CFP Board administers the CFP® certification program, which is the gold standard credential in financial planning. The site guides candidates through the four-part certification process (Education, Exam, Experience, Ethics) and provides career resources, mentorship, and professional development for financial planners.

## Key Topics

- CFP® Certification
- CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER
- Certification Process

## Certification Overview

- [CFP Board | Certified Financial Planner Board of Standards, Inc.](https://www.cfp.net): CFP Board homepage defining CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNER certification standards
- [How to Become a Certified Financial Planner: The Process | CFP Board](https://www.cfp.net/certification-process): Overview of CFP certification process: Education, Exam, Experience, Ethics
- [Why Get Certified | CFP Board](https://www.cfp.net/why-get-certified): Benefits of CFP certification for career and salary advancement
- [CFP® Certification Standards and Accreditation Guide | CFP Board](https://www.cfp.net/why-get-certified/the-standard-of-excellence): CFP standards, NCCA accreditation, and fiduciary requirements guide

## Certification Requirements

- [CFP Education Requirements & Coursework | CFP Board](https://www.cfp.net/certification-process/education-requirement): CFP Board-approved coursework and bachelor's degree requirements guide
- [CFP® Exam Requirements & Eligibility Guide | CFP Board](https://www.cfp.net/certification-process/exam-requirement): CFP exam eligibility, registration, dates, and preparation requirements
- [CFP® Certification: The Experience Requirement | CFP Board](https://www.cfp.net/certification-process/experience-requirement): 6,000 Hour Standard and 4,000 Hour Apprenticeship pathway requirements
- [CFP® Certification: The Ethics Requirement | CFP Board](https://www.cfp.net/certification-process/ethics-requirement): Ethics, fiduciary standards, and background check requirements for CFP
- [CFP® Certification: The Ethics Requirement | CFP Board](https://www.cfp.net/ethics): CFP ethical standards, Code of Ethics, and Fitness Standards reference
- [Final Steps to Earning CFP® Certification | CFP Board](https://www.cfp.net/certification-process/final-steps): Final steps and payment requirements to complete CFP certification

## Exam Preparation & Education

- [CFP® Exam Preparation | CFP Board](https://www.cfp.net/certification-process/exam-requirement/cfp-exam-preparation): CFP exam study guides, practice exams, strategies, and mentor program
- [CFP Education Programs & Courses Online | CFP Board](https://www.cfp.net/certification-process/education-requirement/certification-coursework-requirement/find-an-education-program): Directory of CFP Board-Registered Education Programs and courses

## Candidate Resources & Support

- [Candidate Tools & Resources | CFP Board](https://www.cfp.net/candidate-tools-and-resources): Hub for CFP candidate resources, study tools, mentorship, scholarships
- [CFP Board Mentor Program | CFP Board](https://www.cfp.net/candidate-tools-and-resources/find-a-mentor): CFP Board Mentor Program connecting candidates with certified professionals
- [Apply for Scholarships and Financial Aid | CFP Board](https://www.cfp.net/candidate-tools-and-resources/apply-for-a-scholarship): Scholarship and financial aid opportunities for CFP certification candidates

## Career Resources

- [Explore Jobs & Internships | CFP Board](https://www.cfp.net/for-cfp-pros/career-center): CFP Board Career Center for job search and internship opportunities
- [A Career in Financial Planning | CFP Board](https://www.cfp.net/why-get-certified/a-career-in-financial-planning): Career guide for financial planning with CFP professional profiles
- [Financial Planner Salary With CFP® Certification | CFP Board](https://www.cfp.net/why-get-certified/financial-planner-salary-and-stats): CFP salary data, compensation studies, and career earnings analysis
